nodes.label: Natural vs TTS Feature Distribution Comparison
nodes.description: Box plots comparing 15 audio features (Duration, RMS, LUFS, F0 mean/std/range, Spectral Centroid/Rolloff/Flatness, ZCR mean, Onset mean, HF ratio, MFCC-3 std, MFCC-10/11 mu) between natural speech (n=13) and TTS speech (n=123+). Uses Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney tests with significance asterisks.

metadata.finding: TTS speech differs systematically from natural speech on all 15 acoustic dimensions: louder RMS but quieter LUFS, higher pitch variability, broader/flatter spectrum, higher zero-crossing rate, stronger onsets, shorter duration
